message: GPIO 12: GPIO 12 is a CRITICAL strapping pin. If pulled HIGH at boot, VDD_SDIO switches to 1.8V, which CRASHES 3.3V flash chips. Never connect a pull-up resistor. If using SD card on this pin, burn the VDD_SDIO eFuse: espefuse.py set_flash_voltage 3.3V
GPIO 12 is a JTAG pin. Using it disables JTAG debugging.
